text_block_list.text:
At the Satono Group reception party. 
Behind the scenes, where staff bustled 
back and forth—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna hype up the whole venue with 
our show! Are you two ready?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's give the customers a big surprise!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the magic show 
of the century!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I shall now present a teleportation magic 
trick for you all! —Open the box!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan has stepped into the box! Now we 
wrap it all up with chains and put a whole 
bunch of locks on it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Will Kura-chan truly be able to escape 
from here...?!?

"Lay down cushions below the stage and 
wait on standby. From the trapdoor, she 
will..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Hup.
choice_data_list: You broke out of the pocket nicely!
You broke out of the pocket nicely!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. And after that—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown's Voice
text_block_list.text:
""W-Wait, Dia!? I didn't hear anything 
about it being this cramped...!?""

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ Endure it, Kura-chan. Count to 100, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The voice recorder planted in the box 
seems to be playing back nicely.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, head from the service 
entrance to the stands—

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Miss Crown, th-this is terrible!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Who would have thought the service door 
would break? That's the only way around to 
the audience seating, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't panic, Trainer. We have to look. 
Find a way to move to the spectator seats 
without being noticed—!

I look around to see if there is anything 
useful. All that's here is a pile of small 
styrofoam boxes and a dolly used by staff 
for transport, but...
choice_data_list:
There's nothing that looks usable at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Styrofoam boxes... a handcart...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident! I've found a special 
breakthrough strategy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what became of Kura-chan? Open 
the box!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Kura-chan isn't inside the 
box! Just where on earth did she vanish 
to?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Over here! I'm over here!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh!? When did she get behind us!? —How 
did she move from the stage?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a surprise! A magician never reveals 
her secrets! Did you enjoy the 
performance?

And so, Satono Crown's teleportation magic 
trick was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You couldn't use the service 
entrance? Then how did you...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Maybe you ran through the stands so 
fast that nobody even noticed?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I can't perform miraculous feats like 
that. What I used was a simple trick. The 
hint is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! Why do you think there's a 
handcart here?"
choice_data_list: That's because the staff is using it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Staff pushing handcarts are 
constantly coming and going. Nobody pays 
mind to what's being carted around.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And・so! I'll climb into this Styrofoam 
box right here... and ride a dolly 
straight over to the audience seats!
choice_data_list: What!? Fitting inside such a small box...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just one would be impossible. However, if 
we cut out the bottoms and stack several 
together—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It'll create a large, tall "box." Just the 
right size for me to hide in, wouldn't you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Disguised as a stack of small boxes on a 
cart, you had your Trainer wheel you all 
the way out into the audience seats...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan, that's amazing!! To think you 
could execute a breakthrough like that 
right away!
choice_data_list: And I was about to give up...
And I was just about to give up...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Under those circumstances, it's totally 
understandable. Even I thought 'What do I 
do?' for a second."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, giving up was never an option. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I felt it so acutely upon the stage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They want to be thrilled! Meeting the 
crowd's expectations—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to pull something like 
that, of course I have to wake you up, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A dramatic turnaround that turns the 
impossible into reality—!
choice_data_list:
And having quick wits like that... Truly 
impressive!

I need to learn from that never-give-up 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You were completely brilliant yourself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To carry me while pretending to be staff— 
such nerve, and such acting skills..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, you might actually have the 
makings of an entertainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I love that ambition!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's because you are who you are that I 
can trust you to have my back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: In races, and in magic too... right!
